name: Krea Studio
description: Text-to-image with Krea 2 Turbo on the local ComfyUI: prompt, optional prompt enhancement by the Qwen3-VL text encoder, a gallery and history.
license: Krea 2 weights: Krea license (LICENSE.pdf in Comfy-Org/Krea-2)
notes: Needs ComfyUI (v0.35.0 or newer, with the krea2 CLIPLoader type and the TextGenerate node) running on 127.0.0.1:8188 and installed in ~/ai/ComfyUI: the models are downloaded into ~/ai/ComfyUI/models and generated images are read from ~/ai/ComfyUI/output/krea_studio. ComfyUI elsewhere: copy this manifest to ~/.rigs/appstore/catalog/krea-studio.json and change the model dests and COMFYUI_DIR. ComfyUI holds the VRAM (~18 GB, asked of the GPU Overseer as client comfyui); Krea Studio itself is stdlib Python and needs no venv.
